name: Ironmarrow ChromeSync Conduit Bodysuit
description:
A full-torso, long-sleeve bodysuit in matte black with silver-gray routing channels visible as raised seams along the arms, spine, and ribcage. The channels are functional — flexible conductive conduit pathways that carry low-voltage power and data signals between chrome limb attachments, spinal rigs, and BCI hubs without exposed external cabling. Snap-lock port anchors are recessed along the wrist cuffs and collar.

The fabric itself is a dense, non-stretch biometric weave that holds its shape under chrome weight loads. Worn close to the skin, it prevents the chafing and electrical micro-arcing that comes from chrome-adjacent bare skin. Popular among heavily augmented workers and operatives who need their implants talking to each other.
materials: reinforced shoulder and hip attachment zones
functionality: Routes power and data between chrome limbs, spinal rigs, and BCI hubs via embedded conduit channels — eliminates need for external cabling. Snap-lock anchors at wrists and collar connect directly to standard aug attachment rings. Anti-arc lining prevents micro-discharge burns to surrounding tissue. Supports up to 4 simultaneous aug connections.
what_it_says: Your chrome is serious enough to need infrastructure — this is working hardware, not fashion.
story_hooks: An older Ironmarrow batch uses a proprietary conduit protocol — someone is selling a splice adapter on the black market that lets you tap the data stream passing through the wearer's body.

A chrome-heavy dockworker is the only person keeping a the Gray Zone crew's jury-rigged power grid stable — the conduit bodysuit is routing power from her industrial arm to a heating unit feeding twelve people.
The snap-lock anchors on a recovered bodysuit don't match any standard aug attachment spec — custom hardware, suggesting military-grade chrome that isn't supposed to exist at this tier.
related_entities: Ouroboros Energy Power Distribution Trunk Network

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, form-fitting full-torso layer that hugs the body like a second skin. The matte black base is interrupted by a deliberate network of silver-gray raised seams running vertically down the arms, along the spine, and across the ribcage in an anatomical circuit-board pattern. The effect is part athletic compression, part cyborg infrastructure—industrial but refined.
physical_description.fit: Compression fit; snug against the torso and limbs without restricting movement. Designed to sit flush under armor or outer wear, or worn bare on heavily augmented individuals. The non-stretch biometric weave holds its silhouette even under the weight of chrome limbs and spinal rigs.
physical_description.primary_material: Biometric weave—a dense, engineered synthetic blend with minimal elasticity. Conductive threading woven into raised channel seams. Non-permeable to moisture and electrical interference.
physical_description.texture: Smooth matte base with pronounced raised ridges along all conduit pathways. The channels are tactile, almost quilted in appearance, while the negative space between them remains flat and uniform. Engineered for durability rather than comfort against bare skin.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte black foundation with silver-gray metallic routing channels. No patterns or accent colors—purely functional contrast that emphasizes the internal architecture.
physical_description.closures: Recessed snap-lock port anchors at wrist cuffs and collar neckline. Full-body integration with no visible main closure; pull-on design with stretch panels at shoulders and underarms for donning with chrome limbs.
distinctive_features: Functional conductive conduit seams running spine, arms, and ribcage
Recessed snap-lock port anchors at wrists and neck for limb/rig connections
Biometric weave that resists chafing under chrome weight
Low-voltage power and data signal routing visible as design element
Anatomical seam mapping—channels follow actual augmentation pathways
Matte finish to reduce reflectivity in surveillance environments
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2–3 crossover. Premium functionality at mid-tier pricing—affordable for serious augmentation users but signaling professional chrome work, not luxury.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by augmented workers, corpo operatives with extensive mods, military contractors, and underground 'ware surgeons. Signals someone whose body is optimized for machine-interface work. Not street fashion—this is utilitarian body modification culture.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; shows minor discoloration around port anchors and collar after heavy use. The matte finish hides wear well. Heavily augmented users may have small scuff marks or micro-arcing burns near snap points, but the biometric weave resists visible damage.
